responsibility: Implements the per-insn analysis half of GCC’s legacy reload pass. It scans one RTL insn at a time to determine which operands, addresses, or values must be copied into hard registers to satisfy machine constraints, records reload descriptors and replacement sites, handles operand swapping and equivalence substitution opportunities, classifies reload lifetimes for register sharing, and provides helper predicates for clobbers, increments, and reload-register mode adjustment. It prepares reload requirements; whole-function execution and spill management live in reload1.c.
same_name_distinction: This same-stem source file is specifically the per-insn reload-analysis implementation: it scans RTL to discover reload needs, records replacements, and provides related helper logic such as clobber and mode-adjustment queries. The companion header gcc/reload.h is the broader cross-file interface and data contract shared with reload1.c and caller-save support.
